product.name: dKilo DOOH
product.description: A digital out-of-home advertising platform for creating, targeting, launching, and measuring location-aware campaigns across mobile and fixed advertising screens.

product.name: dKilo Ad Manager
product.description: A centralized campaign-management platform for configuring, launching, monitoring, and reporting on dKilo DOOH advertising campaigns.

product.name: dKilo Advertise
product.description: A mobile application for creating and managing dKilo DOOH campaigns, including location, budget, fleet, creative, status, and delivery controls.

product.name: dKilo Media
product.description: A marketing and digital execution service covering campaign strategy, branding, creative production, web development, social media, and performance marketing.

product.name: dKilo AI Studio
product.description: A service and product-development studio that builds AI systems for business operations, analytics, workflow automation, personalization, and media intelligence.

product.name: AI Decision Intelligence
product.description: An AI analytics service that converts operational and campaign data into insights, decisions, and optimization actions across marketing and business environments.
